content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or unreliable, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-nobody-3|creators]] face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-what-actually-how-works-6|Selling Presets]] their products online. Fortunately, Cloudflare R2 provides a robust solution for digital product storage and delivery, allowing creators to operate sovereignly without the need for conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-18|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed for high scalability and availability, without the exorbitant fees typically associated with cloud storage solutions. For digital creators, this means a reliable way to store and deliver products like ebooks and courses without giving up a significant portion of their revenue to platform fees. Unlike Gumroad, which charges up to 10% on each sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing creators to retain more of their profits. This significant cost difference can translate into hundreds of dollars retained with successful sales, empowering creators to invest back into their projects and grow their businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of using Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage relies on a simple but effective stack that includes Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for payment processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is processed in real-time, ensuring that the payment verification is instantaneous. Once verified, the digital product is delivered directly from Cloudflare R2, leveraging its high-speed and distributed nature. This setup minimizes latency and guarantees that customers receive their products immediately upon successful payment, creating a seamless purchasing experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who are often sidelined by traditional payment platforms due to geographical restrictions or high fees. Creators in Nigeria, Kenya, Pakistan, and other regions can use this architecture to sell a wide range of digital products—from ebooks to plugins—without relying on intermediaries that dictate terms. This infrastructure not only provides autonomy but also ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data and assets, essential for building a sustainable online business.
Keep 99.5% of your profits with NOWPayments compared to others.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful implementation of this architecture includes several key components: Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers for processing, and NOWPayments for payment verification. Each of these elements works in harmony to create a cohesive experience for both creators and customers. Additionally, integrating Google Sheets or Supabase for order management allows for easy tracking and updates, while tools like Google Drive can be used for file delivery. Together, these components form a complete stack that supports the digital commerce needs of creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and creating a new R2 bucket for your digital products. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers to handle payment requests and responses from NOWPayments. Configure your payment settings to allow for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring real-time payment processing. Finally, link your storage bucket to your order management system, whether using Google Sheets or Supabase. This streamlined setup enables immediate product delivery and efficient order tracking, ensuring your customers receive their purchases without delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to retain more profit, as NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. With the right infrastructure, you can effectively reach your audience and sell digital products directly.
Leverage Cloudflare R2 for fast, reliable digital product delivery.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Using Cloudflare R2 combined with NOWPayments minimizes fees to just 0.5%, allowing you to keep more of your sales revenue compared to platforms with higher fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by setting up your own digital store using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly through your infrastructure.
How does NOWPayments work for my digital products?
NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee of just 0.5% per transaction, ensuring immediate payment confirmation.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare R2 for product delivery?
Cloudflare R2 provides fast and reliable storage, ensuring that your digital products are delivered instantly to customers after payment confirmation.
